books.name: entry_watch
books.label: Entry watch
books.blurb: Same scoring as the main book. Setups the cycle would buy are also armed with a price trigger, a size, and the same stop and target. This is the only book the live watcher is allowed to buy when that trigger trades between cycles. The main book only logs those as WOULD BUY.

books.name: risk_giveback_15
books.label: Risk giveback 15
books.blurb: Risk only. The trail still arms at +15% net. Once armed, it sells when the net gain falls to 65% of the peak net gain, and the 7-day exit waits while that trail is armed. The -12% stop stays. Not combined with the other paper books.

books.name: day_trail_arm
books.label: Day trail arm
books.blurb: Day only. A trail arms only when 60% of the peak gain is at least the greater of 4x that trade's round-trip cost and 1x its 1-hour ATR. Once armed, a crossed trail sells. Stop, target, the burst 6-hour hold and the 22:00 flatten stay.

books.name: day_ev_blend
books.label: Day EV blend
books.blurb: Day only. Each sub-strategy's expected value is its measured expectancy blended with the model: (n x measured + 10 x model) / (n + 10). Momentum and burst are measured apart. The Risk win is not changed on this book.

books.name: no_risk_clock
books.label: No risk clock
books.blurb: Risk only. The 24-hour re-entry clock is deleted. The next setup buys when its own confidence and expected value clear. No new-high gate and no stop-out cooldown.

books.name: day_capital_caution
books.label: Day capital caution
books.blurb: Day only, per account. f is that account's Day loss today divided by 15% of that account's start-of-day Day equity, with no cap at 1. Momentum's threshold is its base (0.35, or 0.30 on MON, WLD and XRP) plus 0.30 x f. Burst uses the same f. Size is multiplied by (1 - min(f, 1)). The -15% halt on the whole Day pot stays.

books.name: partial_take
books.label: Partial take
books.blurb: Day and Risk. At the trail arm, sell half and leave the rest on this book's trail. Buy that half back on a later dip only when a fresh expected value clears the hurdle. The fresh value uses a recomputed chance and the percent still available from the current price, not the inverted live EV. Orders in this split may be £1. Every other book keeps the £5 minimum. The sell records the extra fee of splitting one exit into two.
